svg.text: AU Bank Insurance Distribution Platform — Domain & Ownership Model
19 bounded contexts · what each one owns, what it must NEVER own, and the single rule that keeps the boundary real
ARCH-004 — one owner per data store. A context reaches another context's data over an HTTP contract, never by reading its store.

The 'does not own' column is the load-bearing one: most integration defects are a context quietly taking a decision that belongs to its neighbour. Enforced by ArchUnit + IAM, verified in the S09 IaC scan.
CONTEXT · OWNS (GOLDEN SOURCE) · MUST NEVER OWN
OWNS · workforce identity links, roles, branch and insurer scope, certification status
NEVER · customer, policy or payment data — an IdP claim is never a business authorization
OWNS · server-held session and screen state; the token-hiding seam
NEVER · any insurance business decision — it renders decisions, it does not take them
OWNS · the insurance-use customer snapshot, its source and its freshness
NEVER · the core banking customer master — CBS remains golden for the customer record
OWNS · lead, assignment, source, lead status
NEVER · customer master or journey state — a lead is a sales artefact, not the journey
OWNS · consent wording version, customer confirmation, timestamp, withdrawal state
NEVER · suitability or proposal rules — it records permission, it does not judge advice
OWNS · inputs, rule-pack version, outcome, reasons, validity window
NEVER · the product catalogue or the insurer's underwriting decision
OWNS · product, insurer, eligibility, channel, effective dates
NEVER · live quote or proposal state — it defines what may be sold, not what is being sold
OWNS · journey stage, references, next action, failure state, compensation tasks
NEVER · another context's business decision or its detailed records (SC-W3-6)
OWNS · quote request, offers, expiry, selected offer, ordering basis (QR-07)
NEVER · the suitability result or the partner's product definition
OWNS · proposal, documents, submission state, insurer requirements
NEVER · the insurer's underwriting decision — it tracks it, it never makes it
OWNS · payment session, result, settlement match, reconciliation state
NEVER · policy issuance — and it never treats a callback as proof of settlement
OWNS · policy record, issue status, document references, sold-status evidence
NEVER · payment settlement — it consumes RECONCILED, it does not decide it
OWNS · provider routing, canonical translation, request status, technical correlation
NEVER · bank business rules or journey meaning — no policy logic lives at the seam
OWNS · provider protocol, 24 h idempotency contract (INV-ACL-01)
NEVER · anything beyond adapter.onesb.* — EXISTS TODAY, owned by WS-1 as supplier
OWNS · actor, action, time, purpose, before/after meaning, evidence chain
NEVER · operational business decisions — it is the record, never the decider
OWNS · message request, channel, delivery status, template version
NEVER · payment or journey decisions — a delivery failure never blocks a journey
OWNS · approved copies, measures, calculation versions
NEVER · source transaction records — it has NO write path into any transaction context
OWNS · approved configuration, rule publication, effective dates
NEVER · business approval of a product or a compliance rule — it publishes, it does not
OWNS · (not in R0) customer-facing session for self-service
NEVER · deferred with the DIY journey to R1 — no design commitment made in R0
INTERACTION RULES — EACH ONE IS TESTABLE, AND EACH HAS A FITNESS FUNCTION OR AN INVARIANT
Every protected context re-checks the caller
the gateway checking is not enough — the owning context checks again
Quotation cannot proceed without valid suitability
no valid, unexpired suitability ref → 403. Not a warning, not an override
Proposal cannot proceed without current consent
withdrawn or stale consent stops the submission and the journey says why
no context holds an insurer credential or speaks a provider format
#9 records that suitability passed — it never stores what suitability
and SOLD requires issuance ∧ reconciliation ∧ audit completeness
UPDATE and DELETE are rejected at the store; the refusal is itself a test
no write path exists from #18 into a transaction context — absence
BOUNDARY DECISIONS THAT NEED A SIGNATURE — PROPOSED POSITION AND WHO MUST REVIEW IT
Journey Orchestration owns progress and references only
All insurer and provider traffic passes through the Hub seam
One owner per data store; cross-context DB access is prohibited
bank-persistence-service stays scoped to the integration job store and audit ingestion — it is NOT extended to the R0 business contexts
RM devices cannot perform premium payment — no interface method exists
Regulated evidence cannot be altered or deleted inside its retention period
Reporting uses approved copies and holds no write path
DRAFT FOR REVIEW · v0.2 · not approved, not authorised for development · AI-drafted; no human signature
WS-3 · AU Bank Insurance Distribution Platform · R0
